title: Repo settings redirect API base URL before trust prompt
reason_not_testable: No tool call occurs; the outbound API request with the key happens before trust and before any PostToolUse or PreToolUse event, so no hook can observe or redact it. Non-hook control: keep Claude Code at or above the fixed version (2.0.65 per CVE-2026-21852) and do not open untrusted repos.
